scope_decision: only Eczema included; Tinea Corporis, Atopic Dermatitis, Contact Dermatitis, Scabies, and Seborrheic Dermatitis excluded
note_on_naming: SkinDisNet 'Seborrheic Dermatitis' is a distinct condition from HAM10000 'seborrheic_keratosis' and was NOT merged.
note_on_tinea: Tinea Corporis is listed as skipped here, but it was also dropped from the target class list entirely due to insufficient total images (316 combined).
